applies_to: Neptronic SKS4 steam-to-steam (boiler steam heated) humidifiers.
summary: The SKS4 makes clean steam from a building boiler steam supply through a heat exchanger. Its controller exposes BACnet MS/TP and BACnet IP with the same control structure as the SKE4: selectable demand sources, network demand and RH inputs, operating state, alarms and service counters.
notes: Objects and their writable properties are taken from the guide's 'W?' column; Present_Value writable means the BMS can change it.
Units follow the BACnet Server Units setting (Metric or Imperial).

source.title: SKS4 Steam to Steam Humidifier BACnet Communication Module User Guide

integration.summary: Choose a network control profile (MSV 28) or set MSV 43 to Network, then write demand to AV 138 (or room RH to AV 106 with setpoint AV 107). Turn the unit on/off with MSV 83 and alarm on MSV 64 and BV 44.

minimum_points.name: Boiler Power Output
minimum_points.why: Actual steam output of the humidifier %

integration.enable: MSV 83 System Power State is writable (1 = Off, 2 = On); the control source follows MSV 28 Control Profile or MSV 43 with the Custom profile.
integration.heartbeat: AV 223 Network Timeout (1-900 s) sets how long the humidifier tolerates loss of BACnet control communication before it stops; BV 44 Network Control State shows 1 = Fault.
integration.remote_sensors: Room RH from the BMS goes to AV 106 when MSV 33 = Network; setpoints AV 107-109; supply high limit reading AV 122 (MSV 38 = Network) and setpoint AV 123; direct demand AV 138 and high limit AV 139.
setup: MS/TP MAC defaults to 1 (000-254; 128-254 are non-token-passing slaves); baud rate auto-detects (Auto, 9600, 19200, 38400, 76800); Max_Master 127.
Device instance defaults to 153000 + MAC (153001 out of the box) and can be changed from the menu or by writing Device Object_Identifier.
BACnet IP uses UDP 47808 (0xBAC0) by default.
Network/communication settings are in the controller's Integration menu (password 5544); power-cycle after connecting to the network.
Reinitialize Device (warm/cold reset) over BACnet uses the password 'nep'.
gotchas: MSV 'BACnet Server List Mode' chooses which objects are published (Integrator, Advanced, Factory); objects marked Advanced in the guide, such as the program objects, only show in Advanced mode.
Writing Out_of_Service = True disconnects an object from its physical input so the Present_Value can be overwritten; remember to set it back.
The unit signals alarms through object values only; it does not send BACnet event notifications, so poll or use COV.
COV subscriptions are lost on a power cycle.
Lower Max_Master to the highest MAC on the trunk to speed up MS/TP token passing.
